units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 21b">Kidd. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>בעינא אהבתי … ול׳</he> the case requires that he must say, ‘I love my master and my wife’ (<cite ref="Exodus 21:5">Ex. XXI, 5</cite>), which he could not do (if the master were not permitted to give him a gentile slave to wife on account of his being a priest); ib. 22ᵃ <he>ול׳</he> which he cannot say (at the beginning of his servitude). Ib. 4ᵇ <he>היכא דל׳ לשנויי</he> where there is no other reply.
<cite ref="Berakhot 25a:24">Ber. 25ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>מהא ל׳ למשמע מינה</he> from this nothing can be proved.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 97a:6">Snh. 97ᵃ</cite> <he>מריש … ל׳ קושטא וכ׳</he> formerly I thought there is no truth in the world; a. v. fr.
